name: Our Love, Once Perfect, Shattered
original_name: 我们曾经完美的爱情，已然破碎
overview: Emma Shaw and Joe Lowe have been lovers since school days. Emma Shaw is left infertile after saving Joe Lowe, a secret she hides to spare him guilt. When she enrolls their adopted daughter in school, she discovers their marriage is a lie the child belongs to his mistress. As the truth unravels, Emma is abducted and brutally beaten by Joe himself, unaware the woman in the bag is her.  (Source: DramaBoxdb)
